records.text: Owens said Soter Global Ministries did not officially file its paperwork until 2010 despite beginning work before then.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Despite starting to do work before 2010, they didn't officially file paperwork for their global ministries until 2010, right?

verification.notes: Soter Global documents overseas work beginning in 2005, while public IRS-derived records show federal tax-exempt recognition in June 2012. The exact assertion that paperwork was officially filed in 2010 was not confirmed by an authoritative filing record.

records.text: Owens cited Soter Global Ministries' account that in 2008 it taught orphans and elderly people hygiene and self-care in Ukraine and educated young people about human trafficking.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Please allow me to remind you that in these years, 2006, 2005, this is also when Tyler Bowyer is out doing missionary work in this exact same region. In 2008, with this one I just think is weird, they taught basic hygiene and self-care techniques to orphans and the elderly in Ukraine, visited classrooms to provide education to the youth and adolescents regarding human trafficking.

verification.notes: Soter Global Ministries own timeline states that in 2008 it taught hygiene and self-care to orphans and elderly people in Kherson, Ukraine and provided classroom education about human trafficking.

sources.title: Soter Global Ministries - Who We Are and timeline
sources.relevance: The ministry timeline contains the cited 2008 Ukraine hygiene, self-care, orphanage, and anti-trafficking education account.

records.text: Owens said Dr. Philip Goldsberry co-founded a charitable organization that began work in Eastern Europe and later became Soter Global Ministries.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Dr. Philip Goldsberry co-founded a charitable organization which began doing work in Eastern Europe. ... The organization would come to be known as Sodor Global Ministries, and of course They were in Ukraine, and of course they were in Romania helping to provide medical care to orphanages. I kid you not.
